name: Shortcut Chat
summary: Multi-model AI chat that sends one prompt to up to three models and shows the answers side by side, with reusable shortcuts, web search and image generation.
best_for: people who already compare the answers of several AI models by hand and want one subscription with side-by-side answers, web search, image generation and reusable prompt snippets
skip_if: you only use one model, want a free plan to try first, or need a published usage quota or team and seat features, none of which the page states
honest_knock: The usage allowance is the unknown: the page shows it only as a percentage and never says how much the Pro plan includes, so you cannot compare it to the per-message limits of other chat subscriptions. There is also no free plan or trial named on the page, which means paying before you know whether your usage fits.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-08 on shortcutchat.com, dollar amounts as shown on the page) Shortcut Chat sells one subscription in three sizes. Pro is $20 a month or $216 a year, Pro+ is $40 a month or $432 a year, and Ultra is $100 a month or $1,080 a year; the page says annual billing is 10% off. The three plans unlock the same models, up to three answers side by side, unlimited custom shortcuts, image generation and web search. What changes is the monthly usage allowance: Pro+ has twice the Pro usage and Ultra five times. The allowance is shown as a percentage and resets on the day you first subscribed. According to the FAQ you are not charged overage when you hit it; you wait for the reset or upgrade. The page names no free plan and no free trial, and it does not say how big the Pro allowance is. Cancellation is done from your account and access continues to the end of the billing period.

schema_offer.description: Pro, Pro billed monthly; $216 a year when billed annually (10% off); Pro+ $40 a month or $432 a year with 2x the Pro usage; Ultra $100 a month or $1,080 a year with 5x the Pro usage; all plans include up to 3 models at once, unlimited custom shortcuts, image generation and web search; currency shown as a dollar sign only.
